title: How a queue backs up
sub: Producers add jobs, a worker drains them. Watch the backlog when arrivals outrun service.
aria: Bars showing the queue length after each second

params.label: Jobs the worker finishes per tick

breakLabel: 💥 Break it: the worker stalls for 10 ticks
breakOff: Normal run: the worker is healthy.
breakOn: The worker hangs from tick 10 to 19, and the backlog piles up.
learn: When arrivals are greater than service, the queue grows without bound.
A short stall leaves a backlog that needs spare capacity to drain.
